deviations.what: Canvas 1 O3 Purpose picker: each card is a horizontal row — a line-drawn illustration (~50 px: a ledger page · a shopfront · a house with three windows · a domed building with a flag) on the left, label and description to its right; the app stacks a 20 px Material icon (person · briefcase · family · bank columns) above the label
deviations.reason: [screen] DESIGN-PACK O3 asks for 'large illustrated cards … line-drawn, warm'; no illustration assets exist and the card lays out in a column

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O3 Purpose picker: cards are filled with the raised paper colour (lighter than the page) with a hairline border and ~10 px corners; the app's cards take the page colour with a hairline border
deviations.reason: [shared] card surface (raised fill): the canvas draws every card on the raised paper tone (also c1 O1, c1 O5, c1 O7a/O7b); the app's onboarding cards sit on the page colour

deviations.what: Canvas c11–c14 'O3 Purpose · chooses Myself / My business / My family / Our trust': a tapped card takes a navy outline and a check after its label, and a 'Continue' button at the foot wakes (asleep on c1 O3); the app has no selected state and no Continue — a tap hands the purpose straight to the next step
deviations.reason: [screen] the app's tap-to-advance was chosen when S0.3 was built (s0_3_purpose_screen.dart header); four canvases now draw select-then-continue. Interaction model is the owner's call — reported in open
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (the frame decides components); 13 §3.2 row S0.3
